lead.en: What this site changed, when and why. Wording that overreached was corrected before publication, and each correction is listed here.

text.en: The 2030B declaration headed its list "The Eleven Principles of the Ecosystem" but states and lists seven. The heading now reads "Seven principles".

title.en: BCIA is a programme, not an "achievement"

text.en: MetaX reports no findings, so this site says "the first research programme from the beyond".

title.en: KernID: designed on zero-knowledge principles, not yet audited

text.en: No specification or audit is published. The site says it is designed on zero-knowledge principles and has not yet been independently audited.
Use the contact page with the reason set to "Correction". Say where the error is and, if you can, what would show it. Accepted and declined corrections are both recorded.
A correction is recorded whether accepted or declined.
